title: Budget scope remaining tokens
criteria: S3.1: BudgetScope.remaining_tokens is the token limit minus the tokens used, or None when no token limit is set.
S3.2: Spending exactly the cost limit is allowed; only going over it raises.
diff:
diff --git a/voss_runtime/budget.py b/voss_runtime/budget.py
--- a/voss_runtime/budget.py
+++ b/voss_runtime/budget.py
@@ -35,6 +35,12 @@
     def latency_so_far_ms(self) -> float:
         return (time.perf_counter() - (self._start or time.perf_counter())) * 1000.0
 
+    @property
+    def remaining_tokens(self) -> Optional[int]:
+        if self.token_limit is None:
+            return None
+        return self.token_limit - self.tokens_so_far
+
     def add_usage(self, *, tokens: int = 0, cost: float = 0.0) -> None:
         self.tokens_so_far += tokens
         self.cost_so_far += cost
@@ -43,7 +49,7 @@
     def check(self) -> None:
         if self.token_limit is not None and self.tokens_so_far > self.token_limit:
             raise BudgetExceededError(reason="tokens", limit=self.token_limit, observed=self.tokens_so_far, scope=self.name)
-        if self.cost_usd is not None and self.cost_so_far > self.cost_usd:
+        if self.cost_usd is not None and self.cost_so_far >= self.cost_usd:
             raise BudgetExceededError(reason="cost", limit=self.cost_usd, observed=self.cost_so_far, scope=self.name)
         if self.latency_ms is not None and self.latency_so_far_ms > self.latency_ms:
             raise BudgetExceededError(reason="latency", limit=self.latency_ms, observed=self.latency_so_far_ms, scope=self.name)
diff --git a/tests/test_budget_remaining.py b/tests/test_budget_remaining.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_budget_remaining.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+from voss_runtime.budget import BudgetScope
+
+
+def test_remaining_tokens():
+    assert BudgetScope(token_limit=100, tokens_so_far=30).remaining_tokens == 70
+    assert BudgetScope(cost_usd=1.0).remaining_tokens is None

+
+def test_cost_equal_to_limit_allowed():
